title: Uncle Owen
subtitle: Independent
description: Though he never asked to take care of his stepbrother's son, Owen Lars became fiercely protective of young Luke Skywalker. In order to keep Luke safe, he forbade Obi-Wan Kenobi from visiting, and, with the help of his wife, Beru, he would ultimately fight off an Inquisitor. Between his wife, his farm, and his nephew, he simply wanted to live a quiet life, though the Empire made that more and more difficult.
